The '''V-71 Ridge Piranha''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine manufactured by [[Hummel Carbine]]. [[Cy Yunga]]'s [[Cy Yunga's Podracer|podracer]] used two of these engines, which by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] found their way into a [[Wald's Parts|junkyard]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] owned by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].

==Behind the scenes==
This engine first appeared, unnamed, in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer]]'' video game before being named in a video commercial for Watto's shop found on the [[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Episode I Insider's Guide'']] CD-ROM.
